Overview.Name: Sreshta V
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian, avoids non-veg on Friday and Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & sautéed vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & curd
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid dal-based foods and palak completely as requested.
Follow vegetarian meals on Friday and Saturday.
Keep hydration high and avoid long gaps between meals to reduce migraine triggers.
Morning sunlight exposure can support thyroid balance, mood and sleep quality.
Simple meals with regular timing and yoga will improve energy and recovery.
